demoStepCommunityDescription: Public figures of the community: invested capital, members, donations — full transparency.
demoStepExplorerDescription: Look up any Solana address or transaction and bookmark it.
demoStepFimsDescription: Your member space: account, swaps and community features.

demoStepToolsDescription: Devnet airdrop, token creation and transaction inspector.
demoStepVotesDescription: Community decisions are voted here. Your voting power is shown on each vote.
